title: Old Villagers
description: This pack changes the 1.14+ villagers back to their older versions.
body:
## About
This pack changes the 1.14+ Villager and Zombie Villager textures back to their old 1.13- versions. It gives modern Villagers their classic style, featuring only one type: the plains version.

<details>
<summary>Preview of the pack</summary>

![Preview of the pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00cc3dc8bcce4aec3155c444234f9577fb1faf58.png)

</details>

## Utility
The in-game Programmer Art Texture Pack doesn't revert the Villager and Zombie Villager textures back to their older form, which often causes their models and textures to glitch. This pack is here to correct this and take that weird hoodie away for good.

# Disclaimer
Modern professions, such as the Mason, which didn't exist in older versions of the game, will use the profession texture that best matches their profession (e.g., Mason as the Blacksmith).
